exposure: Laser surgery for twin-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS)
outcome: Neurodevelopmental outcome at 2 years of age
cohort: Pregnancies complicated by TTTS treated with laser surgery
finding: Perforation of the intertwin membrane after laser surgery for TTTS occurred in 16% of cases and was associated with a lower gestational age at birth and a higher rate of severe cerebral injury in surviving neonates, but neurodevelopmental outcomes at 2 years were similar.
